definitions.explanation: The final part or termination of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わり⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is the end. / That's all.

examples.japanese: {終|お}わり⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: I cried at the end of the movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終|お}わり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}みに→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。

⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終|お}わり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わっていなくて→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of summer vacation, I'm always in trouble because my homework isn't done.

notes:
{終|お}わり is a noun meaning "end" or "conclusion," derived from the verb ⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ (to end).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終|お}わり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the end of ~
- {終|お}わり⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until the end
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わり⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: that's all / this is the end
- {終|お}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: endless, never-ending

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: end, conclusion (more formal, used for events/sessions)
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧: the last, the final (focuses on the last item/moment)
- ⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧/{終|お}わり: end of a time period (⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧, ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧)
⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まり：02474_hajimari⟧ (beginning)
